module: 3D icons (Skia billboards facing the camera) to mark world positions: missions, stations, race markers. Each icon is drawn with the bngIcons font in four layers (shape outline, fill, pattern edge, pattern). Icons with the same appearance share a billboard pool: releasing one puts it away for the next one of the same style instead of rebuilding a texture. A modder calls getIcon, then update every frame, and release at the end.
usage:
local icon = render_skiaIcons.getIcon('mission', pos)  -- preset from a *.skiaIcon.json file
local icon2 = render_skiaIcons.getIcon({shape = 'circle', motive = 'fuelPump', color = 'blue'})
icon2:setVisible(true)
-- every frame (onPreRender):
icon2:update(pos, render_skiaIcons.screenBoundedScale(pos, 0.8, 0.03, 0.12), dt)
-- at the end:
icon2:release()
notes: Icon spec (all fields optional): shape, motive, text (short label like '3' or '9+' that replaces the motive), motiveScale, motiveOffset, outline (in font units per 24; default 1.5), color, borderColor, motiveColor, and preset (name of an entry of the /art/skiaIcons/*.skiaIcon.json files, key 'presets'). Color names are resolved by the iconMarkerConfig.json table, otherwise the value is taken as is.
On load, the module reads ui/ui-vue/src/assets/fonts/bngIcons/iconMarkerConfig.json and bngIcons.js; if the config is unreadable, loading the extension fails (error).
The engine offers no alpha on billboards: the fade is simulated by shrinking the size down to zero (below 0.005 m the icon is hidden). The size is a height in meters.
The pool keeps at most 192 released billboards; beyond that they are destroyed.
A billboard is only built on the first visible update, which avoids costing a texture for markers that are never seen.
After release() the icon is "dead": request a new icon with getIcon.
The renderer is a scenetree object named 'skiaIconBillboards'; it disappears with the scene (onClientEndMission invalidates all identifiers).
The code of Icon:update has the real signature (pos, scale, dt); the extracted page wrongly shows (scale, dt) because the method is declared with ':'.
Loads the core_skiaTemplate extension on demand.

getIcon.desc: Returns an icon for a preset name, a spec table, or a preset with overrides (spec.preset plus fields). If the style cannot be built, returns an already dead icon (isLive false).

spec.desc: Preset name or spec table (see notes).

pos.desc: World position. If provided, the icon is built and placed right away; otherwise on the first update.

returns.desc: Icon object with update, setPos, setScale, setVisible, visibility, isLive, release.

screenBoundedScale.desc: Computes the world height of an icon that behaves like a real object at medium distance but stays bounded on screen: never below minScreen (readable from afar), never above maxScreen (does not flood the view up close). Bounds are expressed as a fraction of the screen height; equal bounds give a constant on-screen size. Uses the core_camera camera; without a camera, returns worldSize.

worldSize.desc: Height in meters in the intermediate range.

minScreen.desc: Minimum fraction of the screen height (default 0).

maxScreen.desc: Maximum fraction of the screen height (default 1).

returns.desc: World height to pass to Icon:update.

reload.desc: Re-reads the shared config, the glyph table and the presets from disk. Deletes the renderer (all textures); live icons rebuild on their next update.

returns.desc: true if the config could be re-read.

reloadPresets.desc: Forgets the loaded presets so that the next getIcon re-reads the *.skiaIcon.json files. Lighter than reload: already built textures are kept.

returns.desc: {live, looks, pooled, created, reused, destroyed, hasRenderer}.

getMotives.desc: Sorted list of all motive names (bngIcons glyphs).

getPresets.desc: Returns the presets table (name -> spec) loaded from /art/skiaIcons/*.skiaIcon.json ('presets' field).

getFolders.desc: Folders read by the system: presets (/art/skiaIcons) and font.

exploreFolder.desc: Opens one of these folders in the system file explorer (development convenience).

returns.desc: Opened path, or nil if the platform cannot open it.

getColors.desc: Returns the table of named colors of the icon config.

getShapes.desc: Sorted list of available shape names.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads: deletes a 'skiaIconBillboards' renderer left by a previous Lua VM.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: identical to reload().

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-mission hook: the scene and its renderer are lost, all billboard identifiers are invalidated and the pools emptied.

Icon.desc: Icon handle returned by getIcon. Each state method returns the icon itself (except isLive, visibility, release).

sync.desc: Makes sure the icon has a billboard of its current appearance: rebuilds after a reload or after the scene is lost, takes a billboard from the pool or creates one.

returns.desc: Billboard identifier, or nil if there is nothing to draw.

update.desc: Per-frame call. pos and scale keep their current value when nil; dt advances the visibility fade (nil or 0 leaves it in place).

setVisible.desc: Shows or hides the icon with a fade. With instant, skips the fade and pushes the result right away (useful for a hidden marker that is no longer updated).

visibility.desc: Current fade progress between 0 and 1, to sync other visual elements to it.

isLive.desc: False if the icon has no billboard: released, style impossible to build, or no renderer.

release.desc: Puts the billboard away in the pool for an icon of the same style. The handle is unusable afterward.
